summary.intent: Finalize phase 43 (FUSE write durability) for shipping: run CodeRabbit CLI review, cross-check and fix all 8 documented critical findings, run /simplify, capture deferred work as todos, open PR #487, and resolve all reviewer comments.
summary.outcome: PR #487 opened and all CodeRabbit review comments addressed across 5 follow-up commits; all 8 criticals resolved in code (CR-03 TEE-fallback fully purged, CR-04 mutation-ordering fixed), /simplify applied (3 safe cleanups, 6 deferred), 6 todos captured, and codecov wired for Rust crates.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` immediately pushes a `chore(release)` commit to the PR branch; the next local push is rejected until `git fetch` + `git rebase origin/<branch>`.
codecov.yml has both `patch` status and the `desktop` flag set to `informational: true` — codecov failures do not block merge.

crates/fuse and crates/sdk Rust tests (40+43) were invisible to codecov because no `rust` flag path existed; the workspace llvm-cov already collected the data, it was just dropped by the `desktop` flag's path filter.
The `winfsp` feature flag is Windows-only and cannot be compiled locally on macOS; CI runs `cargo check --features winfsp` as the first real compile gate for winfsp edits.
The Entire CLI pre-push hook syncs checkpoints on every push, adding 30–60s latency to all push operations.
CodeRabbit 'nitpick' and 'outside of diff range' comments land in the review body, not as resolvable inline threads — they cannot be resolved via the GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation.
The phase-43 PR commit list contained 22 redundant phase-42 commits (branch predates squash PR #485) but the net diff vs origin/main was phase-43-only; squash-merge collapses the noise.

`crates/sdk/src/sync.rs` contains four pure free functions (sanitize_error, regex_replace_paths, regex_replace_tokens, is_network_error) with 0 tests — log-redaction helpers that are trivially unit-testable.

The `spawn_sync_daemon` function in commands/sync.rs had no idempotency guard — calling it twice (re-auth or IPC) left two daemon polling loops running, doubling WriteParked notifications and defeating the D-10 anti-spam work.

code.finding: CR-03 residual: fallback `.unwrap_or_else(|_| encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default())` was journaling a TEE-wrapped key into the user-key field on wrap failure; fixed to warn+String::new() so replay parks instead of bricking.

CR-03 residual (winfsp path): same TEE-key fallback as write_ops.rs; fixed identically. Also had `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` calls where the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — cosmetic inconsistency, same function via re-export.

CR-04 fix: in-memory mutations (inode.kind, pending_content.insert, queue_publish) previously occurred before journal.put, meaning a prepare/journal failure left partial state and the debounced publisher could emit metadata for a write the OS was told failed. Reordered to defer all mutations until after journal.put — the journal commit is now the commit point.

spawn_sync_daemon had no idempotency guard; added early-return if state.sync_trigger already holds a sender. Without this, re-auth or duplicate IPC calls spawned multiple daemon loops, doubling WriteParked notifications.

resolve_folder_key used `depth`/`MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH` but the variable counts nodes visited, not tree depth. Renamed to `nodes_visited`/`MAX_RESOLVE_NODES`. Straggler reference at line 1089 (error message) was missed in the first rename pass causing a compile error.

TrayStatus::WriteParked was excluded from is_connected() — the only thing is_connected gates is the Logout tray item (tray/mod.rs:96). An authenticated user with parked uploads couldn't log out; fixed by adding WriteParked to the is_connected matches.

ordered_for_replay used a duplicated per-variant sort_by_key match to extract created_at_ms; refactored by adding a JournalOp::created_at_ms() accessor. The journal_no_plaintext test probed a string never inserted into the journal (no-op assert); replaced with meaningful raw-key-bytes assertion.

The sync-daemon D-10 edge-trigger (WriteParked notify-once-then-silence) lived inline in a closure with zero test coverage. Extracted into pure bridge_status(status, prev_watermark) -> TrayBridgeOutcome with 8 unit tests; the closure now just applies it and handles OS side effects.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI review can be scoped to a phase diff using `--agent --base-commit <merge-base>` to avoid reviewing all 105 commits on a long-lived branch.
Parallel verification sub-agents (one per critical finding) are effective for cross-checking prior review findings against current code after a batch of fix commits.
The `/simplify` skill's 4-agent pattern (reuse/simplification/efficiency/altitude) converges strongly; deferred items should be noted in the commit body AND captured as GSD todos before shipping.
codecov body comments containing 'patch' coverage breakdowns (by file) are more useful than the headline percentage when triaging what's actually improvable vs. untestable glue code.
For YAML validation when python/js-yaml are unavailable in the shell environment, `ruby -ryaml -e "YAML.load_file(ARGV[0])"` is a reliable fallback.

1Password SSH commit signing can fail with 'failed to fill whole buffer' after a prior signing failure; the fix is to quit and reopen the 1Password app to recover the SSH agent — retrying without restarting the app will keep failing.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed twice with 'error: 1Password: failed to fill whole buffer / fatal: failed to write commit object' requiring a full app restart before the commit could land.
Push rejected after `gh pr create` because github-actions[bot] immediately pushed a chore(release) commit to the PR branch — required git fetch + rebase before the local push could succeed.
Network timeout during ship push ('Failed to connect to github.com port 443 after 75s') required a connectivity check and retry.

Compile error after the depth→nodes_visited rename: the straggler reference at lib.rs:1089 (error message string) and the doc comment at line 1024 were missed in the first pass, requiring a second read+edit cycle.
Python yaml module unavailable and js-yaml not resolvable from repo root (pnpm strict hoisting) — required ruby fallback for YAML validation.
Write tool rejected pr-body.md with 'File has not been read yet' error (file did not exist yet but tool required a prior read); worked around by using a different filename.

Background task notification showed exit code 0 for a failed git commit (the exit 0 came from `| tail`, masking the underlying git failure) — required reading the raw output file to diagnose the real error.
open_items: Consolidate duplicated fuser↔winfsp upload+mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods — highest-value refactor, security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved, requires winfsp CI gate.

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with Option<String> uniformly plus a wrap_ipns_key_for_journal helper — parent_ipns_key_hex uses sentinel while file_ipns_key_hex already uses Option (inconsistent within one struct).

Extract shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES helper — path and count are triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, and commands/sync.rs; sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at same dir (CR-07 footgun).

Have replay_upload_entry delegate to operations::publish_file_metadata and extract shared cas_publish_parent helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70+40 lines of logic also in write_ops.rs and windows/write_ops.rs.

Memoize resolve_folder_key during replay_for_vault — currently re-walks vault tree from root for every replayed entry; cache in HashMap<ipns_name, folder_key> seeded with root to fix super-linear mount-time replay latency.
Replace string-matching on 'not found' in replay first-publish detection with typed error/Option — resolve_sequence return type change touches 9 call sites and PublishCoordinator.

Add unit tests for crates/sdk/src/sync.rs pure functions (sanitize_error, regex_replace_paths, regex_replace_tokens, is_network_error) — 0% coverage, 24 lines, log-redaction helpers that are security-relevant and trivially testable.

Improve overall phase-43 patch coverage — 50% / 638 lines uncovered; crates/fuse/src/lib.rs replay paths (network-bound) are the largest low-coverage block and require integration-level testing infrastructure.
No unit test asserts the CR-04 guarantee ('prepare failure leaves no partial inode state') — hard to force a journal.put failure in a test but the invariant is critical for durability correctness.
winfsp edits (CR-03/CR-04/simplify) verified only by inspection and CI — cannot be compiled locally on macOS; CI winfsp gate is the first real compile check.
